initialDevelopmentFailuresReportedFromAc.cause: Sleeping original remained an immovable Cannon support when the actual pan began unpowered motion.
initialDevelopmentFailuresReportedFromAc.fix: Wake the same original when its actual support is moving, without pose, velocity or mass writes.

initialDevelopmentFailuresReportedFromAc.failure: Declared handoff initially required simultaneous foot contacts on both cabins and passed 9/10.
initialDevelopmentFailuresReportedFromAc.cause: The actual 0.20 m gap did not produce simultaneous contact. Each real cabin separately received held traveller load.
initialDevelopmentFailuresReportedFromAc.fix: Require positive real held-foot load on each car and actual original pan transfer; no simultaneity claim.
